type_docs.AbsolutePathBuf:
A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

IMPORTANT: When deserializing an `AbsolutePathBuf`, a base path must be set using [AbsolutePathBufGuard::new]. If no base path is set, the deserialization will fail unless the path being deserialized is already absolute.
type_docs.AltScreenMode:
Controls whether the TUI uses the terminal's alternate screen buffer.

- `auto` (default): Use alternate screen mode. - `always`: Always use alternate screen mode. - `never`: Never use alternate screen mode. Runs in inline mode, preserving scrollback.

The CLI flag `--no-alt-screen` can override this setting at runtime.
type_docs.AnalyticsConfigToml: Analytics settings loaded from config.toml. Fields are optional so we can apply defaults.

type_docs.AppLinksConfig: Account settings for a single app.

type_docs.AppToolsConfig: Tool settings for a single app.
type_docs.ApprovalsReviewer: Configures who approval requests are routed to for review. Examples include sandbox escapes, blocked network access, MCP approval prompts, and ARC escalations. Defaults to `user`. `auto_review` uses a carefully prompted subagent to gather relevant context and apply a risk-based decision framework before approving or denying the request. The legacy value `guardian_subagent` is accepted for compatibility.
type_docs.AppsDefaultConfig: Default settings that apply to all apps.
type_docs.AskForApproval: Determines the conditions under which the user is consulted to approve running the command proposed by Codex.
type_docs.AuthCredentialsStoreMode: Determine where Codex should store CLI auth credentials.
type_docs.AutoCompactTokenLimitScope: Selects which part of the active context is charged against `model_auto_compact_token_limit`.
type_docs.AwsAuthRefreshConfig: Command used to refresh AWS credentials for a model provider.
type_docs.AwsCredentialExportConfig: Command used to export AWS signing credentials for a model provider.
type_docs.CredentialProviderConfig: Declarative description of an environment-backed credential family.
type_docs.CurrentTimeReminderDeliveryMode: Which inference boundaries may receive current-time reminders.
type_docs.ExternalConfigMigrationPrompts: Settings for notices we display to users via the tui and app-server clients (primarily the Codex IDE extension). NOTE: these are different from notifications - notices are warnings, NUX screens, acknowledgements, etc.
type_docs.ForcedChatgptWorkspaceIds: Backward-compatible shape for ChatGPT workspace login restrictions in config.toml.
type_docs.GuardianV2ReviewScopeConfigToml: Optional tool-call categories available to the Guardian v2 classifier.
type_docs.GuardianV2TranscriptConfigToml: Bounds and optional sources for the Guardian v2 conversation transcript.
type_docs.History: Settings that govern if and what will be written to `~/.codex/history.jsonl`.
type_docs.KeybindingsSpec:
One action binding value in config.

This accepts either:

1. A single key or chord string (`"ctrl-a"` or `"ctrl-x ctrl-s"`). 2. A list of alternative bindings (`["ctrl-a", "ctrl-x ctrl-s"]`).

An empty list explicitly unbinds the action in that scope. Because an explicit empty list is still a configured value, runtime resolution must not fall through to global or built-in defaults for that action.
type_docs.McpServerAuth: Authentication flow Codex attempts after resolving an HTTP MCP server's configured bearer token and authorization headers, which always take precedence. ChatGPT authentication falls back to stored OAuth credentials when its session provider is unavailable; both modes ultimately fall back to an unauthenticated connection.
type_docs.McpServerOAuthConfig: OAuth client settings used when Codex launches an MCP OAuth flow.
type_docs.McpServerToolConfig: Per-tool settings for a single MCP server tool.
type_docs.ModelProviderAuthInfo: Configuration for obtaining a provider bearer token from a command.
type_docs.ModelProviderAwsAuthInfo: AWS SigV4 auth configuration for a model provider.
type_docs.ModelProviderInfo: Serializable representation of a provider definition.
type_docs.OAuthCredentialsStoreMode: Determine where Codex should store and read MCP credentials.
type_docs.OrchestratorFeatureToml: Settings for a feature owned by the orchestrator.
type_docs.OtelConfigToml: OTEL settings loaded from config.toml. Fields are optional so we can apply defaults.
type_docs.PluginMcpServerConfig:
Policy settings for a plugin-provided MCP server.

This intentionally excludes transport settings: plugin manifests own how the MCP server is launched, while user config owns enablement and tool policy.
type_docs.RawMcpServerConfig:
Raw MCP config shape used for deserialization and supported-field JSON Schema generation.

Fields that are accepted only to produce targeted validation errors should be skipped in the generated schema.

Keep `TryFrom<RawMcpServerConfig> for McpServerConfig` exhaustively destructuring this struct so new TOML fields cannot be added here without updating the validation/mapping logic that produces [`McpServerConfig`].
type_docs.ReasoningEffort: A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.
type_docs.ReasoningSummary: A summary of the reasoning performed by the model. This can be useful for debugging and understanding the model's reasoning process. See https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/reasoning?api-mode=responses#reasoning-summaries
type_docs.ResumeCwdMode: Working directory to use when resuming or forking a session.
type_docs.SessionPickerViewMode: Preferred layout for the resume/fork session picker.
type_docs.ShellEnvironmentPolicyFilter: Assigns a shell environment variable pattern to the include-only or exclude set. Includes do not re-add variables removed by another exclude pattern.
type_docs.ShellEnvironmentPolicyToml: Policy for building the `env` when spawning a process via shell-like tools.
type_docs.SleepToolMode: How the sleep tool is selected when its feature gate is enabled.
type_docs.ToolResultLogConfig: Limit for the text included in `codex.tool_result` log records. This does not affect model-visible output. Raising it can expose more tool data to logs.
type_docs.TrustLevel: Represents the trust level for a project directory. This determines the approval policy and sandbox mode applied.
type_docs.Tui: Collection of settings that are specific to the TUI.
type_docs.TuiAgentsKeymap: Shortcuts specific to the shared agents overview.
type_docs.TuiComposerKeymap: Composer context keybindings. These override corresponding `global` actions.
type_docs.TuiEditorKeymap: Editor context keybindings for text editing inside text areas.
type_docs.TuiGlobalKeymap: Global keybindings. These are used when a context does not define an override.
type_docs.TuiKeymap:
Raw keymap configuration from `[tui.keymap]`.

Each context contains action-level overrides. Missing actions inherit from built-in defaults, and selected chat/composer actions can fall back through `global` during runtime resolution.

This type is intentionally a persistence shape, not the structure used by input handlers. Runtime consumers should resolve it into `RuntimeKeymap` first so precedence, empty-list unbinding, and duplicate-key validation are applied consistently.
type_docs.TuiListKeymap: List selection context keybindings for popup-style selectable lists.
type_docs.TuiPagerKeymap: Pager context keybindings for transcript and static overlays.
type_docs.TuiVimNormalKeymap:
Vim normal-mode keybindings for modal editing inside text areas.

Actions that use uppercase letters (like `A` for append-line-end) should be specified as `shift-a` in config; the runtime matcher handles cross-terminal shift-reporting differences automatically.
type_docs.TuiVimOperatorKeymap:
Vim operator-pending keybindings for modal editing inside text areas.

This context is active only while waiting for a motion after `d` or `y`. Repeating the operator key (`dd`, `yy`) targets the entire line. Pressing `Esc` cancels the pending operator and returns to normal mode without modifying text.
type_docs.TuiVimSearchKeymap: Search motions shared by Vim normal and operator-pending input.
type_docs.TuiVimTextObjectKeymap: Vim text-object keybindings for modal editing inside text areas.
type_docs.Verbosity: Controls output length/detail on GPT-5 models via the Responses API. Serialized with lowercase values to match the OpenAI API.
type_docs.WireApi: Wire protocol that the provider speaks.
